name: Proofbox
summary: A sales app for a bakery with several branches, click and collect and wholesale customers
about: A complete sales app for a bakery with three branches, in soft neumorphic dough tones with a light and a dark theme. Loaves rise on an oven rack as batches are logged against today's plan, live oven timers count down, and click and collect orders move across a board. It also covers a counter till, wholesale standing orders, the bake plan, branches, products and reports.
how: Pick a branch at the top, then watch the loaves rise on Today; tap a tray to log a batch out of the oven.
Sell at Counter till: tap pastries, add LATEBAKE for 30% off near closing, and take cash, card or a wallet.
Drag pickups from Placed to Ready on Click and collect; Ready sends the customer an SMS and Collected takes payment.
Edit any cafe's or hotel's standing order in the week grid and open tomorrow's dispatch list.
Start an oven timer on Bake plan and watch the ring count down until the batch is ready, or let the plan suggest quantities.
Compare branches, edit products and see leftovers in Reports, with 7D, 30D and 12M.
